file_source_records.description: Rabbits, also known as bunnies, are small mammals belonging to the family  Leporidae  (which also includes hares) within the order  Lagomorpha  (alongside pikas). Found throughout the world, they are well-known as herbivores, prey animals, domesticated livestock, and pets, playing an important role in ecosystems and human cultures alike.
